exposure: EFW percentile change per week (> 0%, ≥ 0.5%, ≥ 1%, and ≥ 2%)
cohort: 68 women with shoulder dystocia and 136 controls without shoulder dystocia, all with diabetes
finding: While there was an increased odds ratio for shoulder dystocia among cases versus controls at all fetal growth trajectory cutoffs, this finding was not statistically significant.
